summary_md: **I_Love_Kiwi ([@l_Love_Kiwi](https://x.com/l_Love_Kiwi/status/2115134475877200247))** shares three MIT-licensed Claude Code mods: **cache-clock** (countdown until the prompt cache goes cold, plus /keep-warm), **helper-desk** (task progress bar and live cost per subagent) and **time-left** (self-calibrating ETA).
